before_gym.title: Pre-Workout Nutrition (1-2 Hours Before Gym)
before_gym.goal: Maximize energy levels, preserve muscle mass, and increase focus.
before_gym.guidelines: Focus on easily digestible complex carbohydrates and lean protein. Keep fats and fiber low to avoid stomach cramps during training.
food_options: Oatmeal topped with sliced banana and a scoop of whey protein powder.
3 to 4 whole boiled eggs paired with 2 slices of whole-wheat toast.
Chicken breast with white rice and a side of light veggies.

during_gym.title: Intra-Workout Nutrition (During Gym)
during_gym.goal: Maintain hydration, sustain training intensity, and delay fatigue.
during_gym.guidelines: If your workout is under 60 minutes, plain water is perfect. For heavy, intense sessions lasting longer than an hour, focus on fast-acting liquids.
food_options: Water with an electrolyte tablet or a pinch of sea salt.
BCAAs (Branched-Chain Amino Acids) mixed with water.
A sports drink containing fast-absorbing carbohydrates to replenish glycogen mid-workout.

after_gym.title: Post-Workout Nutrition (Within 1-2 Hours After Gym)
after_gym.goal: Kickstart muscle protein synthesis, speed up recovery, and restock energy.
after_gym.guidelines: Prioritize fast-absorbing proteins to repair muscle tissue alongside fast-acting carbohydrates to replenish spent glycogen.
food_options: A fast-absorbing whey protein shake paired with a ripe banana or rice cakes.
Lean meat (beef or chicken) paired with sweet potatoes or white rice.
An egg-white omelet alongside a large bowl of fruit.

monday.breakfast: Oatmeal, 4 egg whites, 1 whole egg, and black coffee.
monday.lunch: Lean minced beef, brown rice, and mixed green salad.
monday.dinner: Grilled chicken breast, sweet potato mash, and steamed broccoli.
monday.snacks: Whey protein shake and a handful of almonds.

tuesday.day_type: Moderate Carbohydrate / Upper Body Push Day (Bench Press)
tuesday.breakfast: Whole-wheat toast with avocado, 3 scrambled eggs.
tuesday.lunch: Tuna fish salad with olive oil dressing, baked potato.
tuesday.dinner: Turkey breast stir-fry with basmati rice and bell peppers.
tuesday.snacks: Greek yogurt topped with berries and chia seeds.

wednesday.day_type: Low Carbohydrate / Active Recovery or Rest Day
wednesday.breakfast: Omelet made with 3 eggs, spinach, mushrooms, and feta cheese.
wednesday.lunch: Grilled salmon fillet with a massive green salad and avocado slices.
wednesday.dinner: Lean steak (beef) paired with roasted asparagus and cauliflower rice.
wednesday.snacks: Cottage cheese or a handful of walnuts.

thursday.breakfast: Protein pancakes topped with honey and a side of 3 egg whites.
thursday.lunch: Chicken breast wrap in a whole-wheat tortilla with shredded lettuce.
thursday.dinner: Baked white fish (tilapia/cod), quinoa, and steamed zucchini.
thursday.snacks: Rice cakes spread with peanut butter.

friday.breakfast: 4 whole eggs, 1 bagel with light cream cheese.
friday.lunch: Lean beef burgers (no bun) paired with oven-baked potato wedges.
friday.dinner: Grilled chicken breast, whole-wheat pasta with light tomato sauce.
friday.snacks: Whey protein shake mixed with skim milk.

saturday.day_type: Moderate Carbohydrate / Functional Training or Cardio Day
saturday.breakfast: Smoothie made with milk, protein powder, spinach, oats, and peanut butter.
saturday.lunch: Turkey meatballs with brown rice pasta.
saturday.dinner: Baked salmon with a side of mixed roasted root vegetables.

sunday.day_type: Low Carbohydrate / Full Rest and Muscle Recovery Day
sunday.breakfast: Scrambled eggs with smoked salmon and a side of spinach.
sunday.lunch: Chicken salad with olive oil, walnuts, and cucumbers.
sunday.dinner: Grilled lean beef steak with a large side of green beans.
sunday.snacks: Casein protein shake or greek yogurt before bed.
